items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Now he had sent Ziggy Elman some money to rejoin the band, 'cause Ziggy had some liquor stores on the

ctx.x: Well, everybody wanted to laugh. Including me, I cleared out of the dressing room. Everybody on the bandstand just cracking up. Looking at one another, and the more they'd think about it, they'd go back into it.
So when Benny came on the stand, he looked at everyone real strange. Now he had sent Ziggy Elman some money to rejoin the band, 'cause Ziggy had some liquor stores on the
Eastern seaboard, starting with Atlantic City and going up. So Ziggy say, "Can't come. Need more money." Sent him some more money. Ziggy didn't show up.
